keywords: House Select Committee on the CCP
new_fact: On November 17 the chairs of the House Foreign Affairs, China Select and Intelligence committees announced that Huang will give a closed door transcribed interview on December 1 and Nvidia general counsel Tim Teter on December 2, while a person familiar told CNBC the board is not considering his return.
review_note: The November 11 and 13 stories covered the stock slide, the intelligence probe and the resignation itself; this is a new event, the December 1 House testimony agreement announced November 17, told as an update to the November 15 testimony request story.
